{{Image}}
The '''Central Core Shaft''' was a location on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] used a grappling hook to swing across the chasm during the latter's [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescue]]. During the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was destroyed along with the rest of the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].
